title: Ready For Review - [Mouse Jump] - new border style, performance enhancements #50462, #50464

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The focused source assessment traced serialized preview activation, UI dispatch, per-screen screenshot backfill, stale screenshot rejection, and physical-pixel/DIP mapping for pointer navigation. The host now owns the outer border while the preview pane owns screen visuals.

The reported high-severity message-window failure was not established: no current repository caller uses `CreateMessageOnlyWindow`, and an isolated Win32 API probe successfully created a message-only window with the reported process-handle/null-instance combination as well as with a proper-module positive control. A process handle is not a module handle, so using proper module handles remains a reasonable cleanup, but this evidence does not establish an active MouseJump startup defect. The only caller of the generated managed `SendInput` wrapper sends exactly one input, so the proposed partial-send case does not demonstrate a failure of that caller.

**Validation scope:** The paths above and their dependent helpers were inspected, exact-revision diff checks and changed XML/XAML well-formedness checks passed, and the isolated Win32 API contract probe ran. That probe is not execution of the MouseJump product. No full product build, added unit-test run, capture-performance measurement, mixed-DPI/multi-monitor UI scenario or accessibility/theme scenario was executed.

No production-code correction is asserted by this qualified assessment. It does not certify the unexecuted feature scenarios and is not an unconditional approval.
